items.value: Protected by the patent. Grab this kitchen storage rack with 2 power outlets and an air switch button, no need to move your coffee makers, toaster or bread maker to get charged. Enjoy tidy kitchen time in a breeze

items.label: [Removable Shelf]
items.value: Can store higher mini-fridges on bakers rack with storage? Of course. Just install shelves to different pre-drills for different storage heights. items.label: [Not Only a Kitchen Rack]
items.value: Be it a snack rack, coffee bar, flower rack, or study decoration rack, this kitchen shelf organizer rack can meet all. And the vintage wooden grain contrasts beautifully with black legs, fitting your room easily

items.label: [Built to Last]
items.value: This durable microwave stand with storage combines a strong steel frame with sturdy P2 particleboard for a long use span. It will easily stand out for function and style, whether in the kitchen, living room or study

items.label: [No Need to Wait]
items.value: Enjoy the ease of assembly. With all components numbered well and step-by-step instruction provided, this microwave stand will be finished quickly and works as a great kitchen helper. Thickness of P2 Particle Board: 12mm; Thickness of Steel Tube: 18mm
